headlines.summary: 【2.1万亿隔夜逆回购护航跨月 央行“给量不给价”释放清晰信号】中国人民银行日前公告，为更好匹配银行体系短期流动性需求，央行将采用固定利率、数量招标模式，于7月29日至31日每日开展6000亿元隔夜逆回购操作，8月3日追加开展3000亿元操作，累计投放规模达21000亿元。此次隔夜逆回购操作，无论是投放规模还是操作频次，均较6月末首次操作显著升级。同时，操作延续“给量不给价”，仅公布投放数量、未披露中标利率，清晰凸显隔夜逆回购的工具定位：主要用于短期流动性精准调节，而非价格调控作用。

headlines.title_en: A 2.1 trillion yuan overnight reverse repo supports month-end liquidity; PBOC sends clear signal with 'volume without price'
headlines.summary_en: The PBOC conducted 2.1 trillion yuan in overnight reverse repos to safeguard month-end liquidity, sending a clear signal of 'supplying quantity without adjusting price.' The central bank announced it would use a fixed-rate, quantity-bidding model, carrying out 600 billion yuan in overnight reverse repos daily from July 29 to 31, with an additional 300 billion yuan on August 3, totaling 2.1 trillion yuan. This operation significantly escalated in scale and frequency compared to the first such move at end-June. It continued the 'quantity without price' approach, only disclosing the amount lent without the bid rate, underscoring the tool's role in precise short-term liquidity adjustment, not price control.

headlines.title: 新策略实现超高稳定性钠离子电池
headlines.summary: 在国家自然科学基金等项目资助下，广东工业大学材料与能源学院副教授张伟、教授熊世云和教授黄少铭团队在钠离子电池负极材料领域取得重要进展。相关成果近日发表于《先进材料》（Advanced Materials）。该研究首次从路易斯酸碱催化角度揭示了多硒化物转化与穿梭的内在机制，提出了“电子结构调控-双位点自催化-晶格缓冲”协同设计新范式，为开发超长寿命金属硒化物负极材料提供了全新思路，对推动钠离子电池在大规模储能领域的实际应用具有重要意义。（中国科学报）

headlines.title_en: New strategy achieves ultra-high stability sodium-ion batteries
headlines.summary_en: A team led by Associate Professor Zhang Wei, Professor Xiong Shiyun, and Professor Huang Shaomin from the School of Materials and Energy at Guangdong University of Technology has made significant progress in anode materials for sodium-ion batteries, supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China. The findings were recently published in Advanced Materials. The study revealed for the first time the intrinsic mechanism of polyselenide conversion and shuttling from the perspective of Lewis acid-base catalysis, proposing a new collaborative design paradigm of 'electronic structure regulation, dual-site self-catalysis, and lattice buffering,' offering fresh insights for developing ultra-long-life metal selenide anode materials and advancing practical applications of sodium-ion batteries in large-scale energy storage. (China Science Daily)

headlines.summary_en: The Private Securities Investment Fund Committee of the Asset Management Association of China stated that regulators are closely monitoring extreme situations. The Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing stock exchanges have set monitoring indicators for 'large-volume short-term transactions,' classifying rapid, massive trading that triggers significant index volatility as abnormal. Exchanges will take self-regulatory measures in such cases to mitigate the adverse impact of quantitative trading on market stability. (Yicai)

headlines.title: 住户存款少增3.19万亿元背后：从表内定存到资管市场 一场静水流深的居民财富再配置
headlines.summary: 【住户存款少增3.19万亿元背后：从表内定存到资管市场 一场静水流深的居民财富再配置】李啸（化名）曾是坚定的“存款派”，把多年积蓄“锁”在银行等待买房时机。可这两年，1年期定存利率已降至1%左右，他的想法随之转变：短期继续租房，把存款“搬”出来重新规划。这或许是近年来众多家庭资产配置变化的一个缩影。日前，央行公布的数据显示：2026年上半年，住户存款增加7.58万亿元，同比少增3.19万亿元；非银行业金融机构（券商、基金、保险、理财子公司等）存款增加4.65万亿元，同比多增2.1万亿元。

headlines.title_en: Behind the 3.19 trillion yuan drop in household deposits: from on-balance-sheet time deposits to asset management markets, a quiet reallocation of household wealth
headlines.summary_en: Behind the 3.19 trillion yuan decline in household deposit growth: a quiet reshuffling of household wealth from time deposits to asset management markets. Li Xiao (pseudonym), once a staunch 'deposit advocate,' kept his savings in banks awaiting a home purchase. But with one-year fixed deposit rates falling to around 1%, he shifted strategy: renting for now and moving deposits to new plans. This mirrors changes in many households' asset allocations. PBOC data shows that in H1 2026, household deposits rose by 7.58 trillion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 3.19 trillion yuan, while deposits at non-banking financial institutions (securities, funds, insurance, wealth management units) increased by 4.65 trillion yuan, a year-on-year rise of 2.1 trillion yuan.

headlines.title_en: Key capital market events next week: A-shares and Hong Kong stocks welcome major IPOs; tech giants like Apple, Microsoft, and SK Hynix report earnings; the suspense over a July US rate hike will be revealed
headlines.summary_en: Key capital market events next week: Major IPOs on A-shares and Hong Kong stocks; earnings reports from Apple, Microsoft, SK Hynix and other tech giants; US July rate hike decision due. 1. ChangXin Memory Technologies will list on the Shanghai Stock Exchange's STAR Market on July 27, 2026. Zhongji Innolight is expected to list on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on July 30, 2026. 2. The US earnings season continues, with several high-profile companies reporting next week. Monday: AstraZeneca (pre-market), Cadence Design Systems (after-hours); Tuesday: Coca-Cola (pre-market), Boeing (pre-market), GSK (pre-market), Barclays (pre-market), Hilton (pre-market), KLA Corporation (after-hours), Seagate Technology (after-hours), Rio Tinto (after-hours), NXP Semiconductors (after-hours); Wednesday: Deutsche Bank (pre-market), Johnson Controls (pre-market), UBS (pre-market), Microsoft (after-hours), Meta (after-hours), ARM (after-hours), Qualcomm (after-hours), Starbucks (after-hours); Thursday: Apple (after-hours), Amazon (after-hours), Vale (after-hours), Coinbase (after-hours), Strategy (after-hours).

headlines.title: 中东股市收盘播报｜沙特阿美周日收跌将近0.9%，埃及股市跌超0.9%
headlines.summary: 周日（7月26日），沙特证交所全股指数收跌0.34%，报10766.84点。 沙特阿美收跌0.89%，报26.60沙特里亚尔。 在沙特上市的Albilad南方东英MSCI香港中国股票ETF收跌0.72%，报10.96沙特里亚尔。 埃及证交所EGX 30指数收跌0.95%，报53417.59点。 阿曼MSM 30指数收涨0.15%，报7127.88点。 卡塔尔证交所指数收跌0.29%，报10003.67点。 科威特证交所超级市场价格回报指数收涨0.57%，报9123.98点。

headlines.title_en: Middle East stock market close: Saudi Aramco falls nearly 0.9% on Sunday, Egyptian stocks down over 0.9%
headlines.summary_en: On Sunday, July 26, the Saudi Stock Exchange Tadawul All Share Index closed down 0.34% at 10,766.84 points. Saudi Aramco fell 0.89% to 26.60 Saudi riyals. The Albilad Southern East MSCI Hong Kong China Stock ETF traded in Saudi Arabia closed down 0.72% at 10.96 Saudi riyals. Egypt's EGX 30 Index closed down 0.95% at 53,417.59 points. Oman's MSM 30 Index rose 0.15% to 7,127.88 points. Qatar Exchange index fell 0.29% to 10,003.67 points. Kuwait Stock Exchange Super Market Price Return Index rose 0.57% to 9,123.98 points.

headlines.title: 国家数据局党组书记、局长刘烈宏赴上海市调研数据要素市场化配置改革工作
headlines.summary: 7月16-18日，国家数据局党组书记、局长刘烈宏带队赴上海市，实地调研上海数据集团、上海数据交易所、上海申康医院发展中心、智元创新（上海）、它石智航、零数科技、无问芯穹、优咔网络、灵犀云、垣信卫星、国泰海通证券、松鼠云上技术等公司，围绕数据基础设施建设、数据资源开发利用、数据流通交易、具身智能、脑机接口等，深入了解数据要素市场化配置改革工作推进情况。

headlines.title_en: Liu Liehong, Party Secretary and Director of the National Data Bureau, investigates data factor market-oriented allocation reforms in Shanghai
headlines.summary_en: From July 16 to 18, Liu Liehong, Party Secretary and Director of the National Data Administration, led a delegation to Shanghai to conduct field research at companies including Shanghai Data Group, Shanghai Data Exchange, Shanghai Shenkang Hospital Development Center, Zhiyuan Innovation (Shanghai), Tashi Zhihang, Zero Tech, Wu Wen Qiong, Youka Network, Lingxiyun, Yuansatellite, Guotai Haitong Securities, and Songshuyunshang Technology. The research focused on data infrastructure construction, data resource development and utilization, data circulation and trading, embodied intelligence, and brain-computer interfaces, gaining insights into the progress of market-oriented allocation reform of data elements.
